shared_conventions.schema: Each card: character_id, gender (+gender_note), hair, eyes, skin, face, build (height_range_cm, body_type, posture), scale_reference, marks[], signature_items[], base_age_range (+base_age_source), default_outfit_tone (+default_outfit_tone_source), period_silhouette_1862, sup002_coding (touches + restraint), prompt_base_en, doubling. Every field carries source_chapter/paragraph/quote or inferred:true + reason; 'inferred_parts' marks the designed sub-values of an otherwise sourced field.
shared_conventions.gender_vocab: male | female (English project; SOUL 男/女 equivalent). No presented_gender needed in this batch — no cross-dressed or performer-gender cases.
shared_conventions.sup002: All 14 are human performers in 1862 dress; animal/card cues are light (palette, collar/mantle/cape, gloves or mitts, a nose accent, gait). Every card has an explicit 'restraint' line: no masks, wings, shells, fur suits or creature anatomy; faces stay human.
shared_conventions.scale: height_range_cm is the performer's true height. On-screen relative size is handled by SUP-003 forced perspective/scaled sets and described in scale_reference against Alice (~135-140 cm, age ~10, designed on her own card). Caucus-race party members share the shrunken Alice's scale as peers; the Caterpillar is exactly her size (both three inches, ch005-p45).
shared_conventions.wet_entry: Caucus-race company members carry an entry_state: first seen dripping wet on the pool bank (ch003-p01); base look is the dry look.
shared_conventions.costume_boundary: Only base look and outfit tone given; full costume systems are 06-art/costume (Phase 4). House of Hearts livery colours follow politics.json FAC-house-of-hearts emblem_visual.

key_decisions: Gender fixed for index 'unspecified' entries: Duck male, Lory female, Eaglet female, Canary female (a mother calling her children, ch003-p47), Magpie male — all inferred with reasons. Old Crab and Young Crab are female from the source (ch003-p43 'her daughter' / 'Ma'), not inferred.

Lory (20-25) and Young Crab (19-23) are deliberately older than Alice's mid-teens sister and visually distinct, so no unruled doubling is implied (ruling 5.3 B limits doubling to housemaid/Mary Ann, Dinah/Cheshire Cat, sister at the trial). None of the 14 characters in this batch is a doubling pair; doubling = null on all.
Knave of Hearts: face-card Jack look (rolled shoulder-length coif, thin moustache) with a flat card-tabard for 'made entirely of cardboard' (ch012-p51); chains scoped to the trial only (ch011-p01).

Mock Turtle carries both turtle (tortoiseshell cape, flipper-mitts from 'flappers', ch009-p79) and calf cues (SUP-010: calf-hide cap/ear flaps, hoof spats, tail tuft); Gryphon carries eagle (feather mantle, beak nose) and lion (mane hair, paw gauntlets, ch009-p75) cues.
Caterpillar: human in a banded blue smoking gown with a long row of buttons; antennae carried as waxed upswept eyebrows.
Fish-Footman: fish face done by make-up/light prosthetic only; sourced powdered curled hair (ch006-p01) and oversize letter (ch006-p02).
exclusions: CHAR-tortoise: told-only, excluded per work order.
No *-ensemble entries were in this batch, so no group card was written.
The Canary's children (ch003-p47) are not registered in characters/index.json and have no card; if shown they are background extras — character-manager to decide.

conflicts.summary: index.json gender 'unspecified' for CHAR-old-crab / CHAR-young-crab contradicts ch003-p43 (both female); plus alignment note for the five inferred genders.

notes_for_downstream: 06-art/art-director: refs/style/alice.jpeg (the whole-film style reference) depicts a literal giant blue caterpillar creature. Locked SUP-002 requires human performers, so CHAR-caterpillar's card follows SUP-002 and takes only the palette/mood (slate blue with moss-green patina, hookah, mushroom, candlelit gloom). Please confirm when writing style.json that the reference governs look and light, not creature rendering.
Defect numbering uses the 201+ segment to avoid collision with the parallel appearance batch (which already uses DEF-p3-appearance-001/003).
